## Your Dog Grooming Questions Answered!

##### Why Mobile Dog Grooming?

Mobile dog grooming provides the lowest stress, most convenient grooming experience for the whole family! We all want more time and less stress in our lives – dogs and people alike.  We believe that mobile grooming offers the lowest stress environment for you and your pet. No more anxious high-stress days at the salon for either of you. We want you to enjoy your precious time while we pamper your pet in our luxury vans at your doorstep.

##### What is Wagmore Co's Mobile Grooming Service Area?

Wagmore Co provides **mobile dog grooming throughout the west metro Minneapolis area and North Loop**, including Wayzata, Minnetonka, Eden Prairie, Edina, Plymouth, St. Louis Park, Excelsior, Maple Grove, Hopkins, Deephaven and nearby communities. Our fully equipped grooming vans come directly to your home, so your dog can enjoy a calm, one-on-one grooming experience without the stress of traveling to a salon.

If you’re unsure whether we service your neighborhood, please contact us (text or call) [763-307-6978](tel:7633076978) or email us at [info@wagmoreco.com,](mailto:info@wagmore) and we’ll be happy to help. You can also check if we service your area by clicking [here](https://booking.moego.pet/ol/landing?name=WagmoreLLC). 

##### What Dog Grooming Services Does Wagmore Co offer?

**Wagmore Co provides luxury mobile dog grooming and bathing services throughout the west metro Minneapolis area, including Wayzata, Minnetonka, Eden Prairie, Plymouth, Maple Grove, Edina, Excelsior, Hopkins, and surrounding communities.**

We offer full-service dog grooming, dog bathing, deshedding treatments, nail trimming, sanitary trims, teeth brushing, paw pad trimming, brush-outs, and haircut services directly at your home in our fully equipped mobile grooming vans.

We groom many popular breeds including Goldendoodles, Bernedoodles, Labradoodles, Poodles, Golden Retrievers, Australian Shepherds, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, Shih Tzus, and more. Wagmore Co typically services dogs up to 80 lbs, with larger dogs considered based on groomer approval.

Our mobile grooming experience is designed to provide one-on-one attention in a calm, low-stress environment without the need to travel to a grooming salon. Learn more about our mobile dog grooming services, dog bathing, deshedding treatments, and pricing on our [Services page](https://wagmoreco.com/services/).
